setup.heading: Starting positions
setup.premiumGate: Simulation with ranked settlements and roads requires Premium. You can start a 14-day free trial.
setup.scoringHint: Strategy applies only to you. Recommended gets a gold outline — you choose. Open “Score breakdown” during placement for details.
setup.placeholder: Choose who you are, name players and colors. Everyone places manually in draft order: confirm settlement, then confirm opening road. Pick a strategy with the buttons — gold outline marks the recommendation on your turn. Harbor is in the same picker.

strategy.hintHarbor: Harbor activates on your turn when plans exist. Gold outline appears during placement.

settings.title: Settings
settings.allowAdjacent68Desc: Allows number tokens 6 and 8 next to each other
settings.allowAdjacent212Desc: Allows number tokens 2 and 12 next to each other
settings.allowSameResourceDesc: Allows two identical resource tiles next to each other
settings.allowSameNumberDesc: Allows two identical number tokens next to each other
settings.randomHarborsDesc: Shuffles edge piece order (B1–B6). Each piece keeps its relative harbor layout. Off = original order.
settings.bonanzaBoardDesc: Draws 19 of 30 resource and number tiles from the combined pool (18 base + 28 extension = 46). May yield two deserts, many of one type — or none.
settings.bonanzaLocked: Locked — start a free trial to use Bonanza

premium.title: Premium
premium.freeBoards: You can generate as many standard boards as you like for free. Premium unlocks advanced board variants and placement coaching.
premium.perkBonanza: Bonanza board (random pool from base + extension)
premium.perkStrategy: Strategy and harbor advice during placement
premium.perkMidgame: Midgame: road network / longest road, cities, and robber tips
premium.footerNote: 14-day free trial · then subscription (coming to the app stores)

sim.done: Done! Stats are shown under the board.

midgame.title: Midgame
midgame.addRoadFrom: Add road from (your settlement/city or tip)
midgame.robberHint: Recommended hexes for the robber (hits opponents, spares you).

photo.title: Board from photo
photo.introLand: Upload a photo from as straight above as possible, align the hex overlay, and run recognition. Fix mistakes in the grid, then confirm harbors.
photo.introHarbors: Harbors are not recognized from the photo. Match edge-piece order to the photo before using the board — otherwise harbor advice will be wrong.
photo.harborCount: {{count}} harbors · match the photo before Premium sim
